name: Chayote
siboNotes: Chayote is well-tolerated on SIBO diets as it's naturally low in FODMAPs and fiber content is moderate.
preparationTips: Can be eaten raw in salads or cooked like summer squash
Remove the single large seed before cooking
Steam, sauté, or add to stir-fries for best digestibility
Mild flavor pairs well with stronger seasonings
pairsWellWith: Fresh herbs like cilantro or parsley
nutritionalHighlights: Low in calories and high water content
